neighbours.label: a word that judges something as beneficial or favourable to someone (an advantage, advantageous, at its best), as against the same frame judging it harmful or neutral
fire: For a young team, playing at home turned out to be a big advantage in the final.
Many growers find it advantageous to prune their trees in late winter.
The tomatoes from this farm are at their best in early September.
Speaking two languages proved to be a huge advantage in her new job.
Planting cover crops is advantageous for the soil over many years.
The coastal trail is at its best just after sunrise on a clear day.
For small shops, the new tax rule offers a real advantage over online sellers.
Investors say it is advantageous to start saving while you are young.
quiet: For a young team, playing at home turned out to be a big problem in the final.
Many growers find it risky to prune their trees in late winter.
The tomatoes from this farm are usually picked in early September.
Speaking two languages was rarely needed in her new job.
Planting cover crops takes extra work for farmers each autumn.
The coastal trail is often muddy just after sunrise on a cold day.
For small shops, the new tax rule creates a real burden compared with online sellers.
Investors say it is hard to start saving while you are young.
